essays.text: What is “mega-event marketing”? In the course of international publicity andpublic diplomacy, what aspects and key points must be considered in thepromotion and participation of mega-events? (25%)

What are the challenges or barriers faced by the news media over the coverageof international affairs? Please discuss how the challenge or barrier influencesthe performance of international news report with an example. (25%)
Do you agree or disagree with the concept of cultural imperialism orhegemony, particularly in light of “the World System” theoretical perspective?Please elaborate. (25%)

mcq.q: The annual press freedom ranking by the Freedom House is based on three sub-aspects. Which of thefollowing is NOT among them?
Which of the following international communication theories is the dominant paradigm before the WorldWar II?

Fake news is rampant all over the world. In addition to the establishment of non-governmental fact-checking organizations, the UNESCO also calls for attention to media and information literacy. Which ofthe following statements about media and information literacy is NOT correct?
opts: Media literacy focuses not only on reflection and critique of media content, but also on the skills ofaudience to create content.
With the development of communication technology, media literacy has become more diverse, includingreading literacy, visual literacy, and digital literacy.
For generations of digital natives, media literacy is not just about using and criticizing the media, butalso about the capacity of public participations.
A wide variety of user-generated content is the main source of fake news. Therefore, media literacyshould advise people to completely reject user-generated content.

mcq.q: Which of the following descriptions about Taiwan+ (Taiwan Plus) is NOT correct?
opts: It is the first free English-language international streaming platform in Taiwan.
It is a project commissioned by the Ministry of Culture and executed by the Radio Taiwan International.
Its service was officially launched in August 2021.
The platform had screened the Taiwanese historical drama series SEQALU: Formosa 1867.

mcq.q: Which of the following descriptions concerning the planet’s rising temperature is correct?
opts: The term“climate change”is more scientific, while“global warming”is more political.
In the United States, the Republican Party is slanted toward the conception of global warming.
The United Kingdom is the first major economy to legitimize the concrete goals of carbon reduction.
Under the 2015 Paris Agreement, nations collectively agree to keep warming“well under 5 degrees”by the end of this century.

mcq.q: The idea of“de-Westernization”has emerged in the study of international communication. Which of thefollowing statements about de-Westernization is NOT correct?
opts: Global media events such as the Olympics, the World Cup, and the Academy Award testify that mediaglobalization rings true, and the claim of de-Westernization is only a fake issue.

Most mainstream media studies focus on Western media. Many media issues in the Global South cannotbe properly accounted for by existing Western theories, thus bringing greater importance to the de-Westernization of media research.

De-Westernization theses emphasize the need to break the United States-centered mindset. The reasonis that the United States dominates international communication issues due to its strong position ininternational politics and culture.
To de-Westernize and at the same time communicate with the international community, it is necessaryto build“case knowledge”rooted in local societies or cultures.

mcq.q: Which of the following international organizations is NOT headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
The program format of Idol was widely purchased and adopted in many countries. Which country is thisformat originated from?
Which of the following statements about Mainland China’s “Grand Propaganda Campaign” is NOTcorrect?
opts: After 2010, Mainland China began to acquire Chinese-language social media from all over the world,thereby creating a publicity network for overseas Chinese.

After 2010, in addition to disseminating information via the official media, Mainland China’s“GrandPropaganda Campaign”paid more attention to the idea,“Tell China’s Story Well and Spread China’sVoice Well,”to market its soft power.

In 2017, the National Endowment for Democracy used the term “sharp power” to explain that theChinese Communist Party not only exports cultural activities and national image, but also its autocraticand authoritarian system.

The so-called“Red Infiltration”refers to Mainland China’s massive acquisitions of or investments inpro-China media, which enables the news media to incorporate pro-China ideology into news contentvia self-censorship.

mcq.q: The impunity for war crimes committed by which of the following countries after the cold war promptedRussia’s Vladimir Putin to adopt similar tactics amid the invasion of Ukraine?

In the“Cambridge Analytica scandal,”the British political consulting company collected user’s data fromwhich media platform, with an attempt to influence the outcome of the 2016 United States presidentialelection?
Which of the following cases of merger and acquisition of media companies has NOT happened?
Which of the followings is NOT one of the“Big Three”film festivals of the world?
Several renowned food companies shut down their operations in Russia as a token of protest againstRussian invasion of Ukraine. Which company was NOT among them?
In international communications, when the government is compelled to react instantaneously to round-the-clock international news reporting and make related decisions, it is called:

Which of the following countries passed the“News Media Bargaining Code”in 2021, setting a precedentfor requiring large digital platforms pay local news publishers for reprinting or linking news contents ontheir platforms?
Which of the following international film groups awarded Taiwanese director Ang Lee “LifetimeAchievement Award”?
opts: British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA).
The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS).
The organizing committee of Berlin International Film Festival.
The organizing committee of Venice International Film Festival.

mcq.q: IFCN (International Fact-Check Network) is committed to combatting misinformation around the worldvia fact checking. Which of the following statements about getting certified by IFCN is NOT correct?
opts: The fact-checking methods are standardized and transparent, and the reasons for checking are fullyexplained to the public.
The details and evidence of fact-checking should be made public. Therefore the general public canreproduce the work.
IFCN will give a verbal warning once a member organization violated fact-checking criteria, and itsmembership will be suspended for one year.
Information such as organizational structure, funding sources, personnel and their professional backgroundsshould be fully disclosed.
